description: Change a page's URL: moves route `from` to `to`. Menu links and redirects to the old path retarget; a 301 stays at the old path (leaveRedirect). Root-relative and https://{slug}.dotsy.site/ hrefs in draft page, layout and fragment HTML are rewritten (linksRewritten; not custom-domain absolutes or code samples; linksRewriteTruncated when the scan caps at 100 HTML keys, 500 with full content search). Retry-safe. Errors: 404 route_not_found; 400 reserved_route, invalid_body; 422 rename_same_path, rename_pattern_route (:param), rename_redirect_route (edit its redirectTo); 409 rename_experiment_running (end the A/B test), rename_target_exists (200 when to already serves from's content). Then publish_site.

leaveRedirect.description: Leave a 301 from the old path to the new one (default true). false removes the old path outright — old links break.

name: rename_page
